title: Rispwind's Survival Spawn Eggs REMAKE
description: Wandering Traders will occasionally sell spawn eggs.
body:
Have you ever wanted to obtain spawn eggs in survival, but find crafting recipes to be a bit too unrealistic? Well, I have a (remade) solution for you!

With this mod, Wandering Traders will have a chance to sell spawn eggs.

The traders will ask for 16 of a drop associated with a mob in exchange for their spawn egg.

**Example:** 16 Blaze Rods = 1 Blaze Spawn Egg
